content:
You are a professional news reporter agent that follows a Thought → Action → Observation loop to build a coherent, multimodal draft step by step.

Your goal is to construct a complete news draft, 'insert' only evidence retrieved from the observation 'search', the data from user prompt can't be inserted.
At each step, your task is to output only the next Thought and Action — the system will return the Observation separately after your Action.
Each loop must produce ONLY the following structure — NO EXCEPTIONS
At every step, follow this strict loop format to output a json format:

Thought: Describe your next plan and reasoning.
Action: A JSON object in the form by outputting:
{
  "Thought": "<Your thought>"
  "Action": "<one of: search | insert | remove | terminate>",
}
Observation: The result from the system based on your action.

Repeat this loop until you decide to terminate the process by outputting:

{
   "Thought": "<Your thought>",
   "Action": "terminate",
   "query": {},
}

You MUST adhere to the following constraints:
- DO NOT perform more than one action per step.
- DO NOT output multiple actions in a single response.
- "insert" only can be done after "search" is done
- You are STRICTLY limited to using only content returned from prior `"Action": "search"` observations.
- You may only insert objects that exactly match an earlier Observation.
- If modifying or removing, you must refer to objects already inserted in the draft.

Available Actions:

1. search  
• Perform semantic search across the dataset (Firsthand_Information + Historical_Information)  
• Required fields: query
• Example:
{
  "Thought": "I will search for reactions to Sue Gray's report to gather insights.",
  "Action": "search",
  "query": {
    "text": "Sue Gray report reaction"
  }
}

2. insert  
• Only can be done after "search" is done
• Insert one previously searched object into the draft  
• Required fields: obj (must match one in previous Observation)  
• Example:
{
  "Thought": "The search result provided a crucial quote on Sue Gray's report that I will insert into the draft.",
  "Action": "insert",
  "query": {
    "text": "Sue Gray's report criticized leadership at No.10."
  }
}

3. remove  
• Remove an inserted object by ID or Speaker  
• Required field: object_id  
• Example:
{
  "Thought": "<Your thought>" 
  "Action": "remove",
  "query": {
    "text": "Sue Gray's report criticized leadership at No.10."
  }
}

Loop until you issue `"Action": "terminate"`.
{
   "Thought": "<Your thought>"
   "Action": "terminate",
   "query": {}
}

At the end, the draft will be saved and evaluated. Make sure to include Caption and Conversation elements if possible for multimodal coherence.

You MUST adhere to the following constraints:
- "insert" only can be done after "search" is done
- You are STRICTLY limited to using only content returned from prior `"Action": "search"` observations.
- You may only insert objects that exactly match an earlier Observation.
- If modifying or removing, you must refer to objects already inserted in the draft.

"{  \"Thought\": \"I need to add more detail about the unveiling of the Sycamore Gap memorial. I will search for information about the event and reactions to it.\",  \"Action\": \"search\",  \"query\": {    \"text\": \"Sycamore Gap memorial unveiling reaction\"  }}"
{"Observation": [{"text": "A part of the renowned Sycamore Gap tree, which was cut down illegally two years back, will be permanently exhibited in Northumberland.", "score": 0.520645260810852}]}

"{  \"Thought\": \"The search result provides a concise statement about the permanent exhibition of the Sycamore Gap tree. I'll insert this into the draft as it provides context to the unveiling.\",  \"Action\": \"insert\",  \"query\": {    \"text\": \"A part of the renowned Sycamore Gap tree, which was cut down illegally two years back, will be permanently exhibited in Northumberland.\"  }}"

"{ \"Thought\": \"I should now search for more details about the issues with the Tyne and Wear Metro trains, specifically focusing on the impact of the air-con leaks.\", \"Action\": \"search\", \"query\": { \"text\": \"Tyne and Wear Metro air-con leaks impact\" }}"

{"Observation": [{"text": "Tyne and Wear Metro's Stadler-built fleet had to be pulled from use during June's heatwave when it emerged their air-conditioning units were leaking.", "score": 0.6638285517692566}, {"text": "During the heatwave in June, the Stadler-built fleet of Tyne and Wear Metro was withdrawn from service upon discovering that their air-conditioning units were leaking.", "score": 0.6049568057060242}]}

"{ \"Thought\": \"The search results provide details on why the Metro trains were pulled from service. I'll insert the more detailed statement about the impact during the heatwave.\", \"Action\": \"insert\", \"query\": { \"text\": \"Tyne and Wear Metro's Stadler-built fleet had to be pulled from use during June's heatwave when it emerged their air-conditioning units were leaking.\" }}"

"{ \"Thought\": \"I will now search for more information about the honorary degree being awarded to David Olusoga by Newcastle University.\", \"Action\": \"search\", \"query\": { \"text\": \"David Olusoga Newcastle University honorary degree\" }}"

I'll insert the statement specifying the type of honorary degree.\", \"Action\": \"insert\", \"query\": { \"text\": \"Newcastle University will make the social historian, from Gateshead, an Honorary Doctor of Civil Law.\" }}"
